rv.q: RB Dance Company have created a wonderfully nuanced, balanced show that champions the talent and versatility of the 10 brilliantly dedicated dancers.
All in all, this tiny number of noticeable instances was an extraordinary achievement in a show which chases danger and is thrillingly exciting, sexy and powerful as a result.
Stories: The Tap Dance Sensation was a unique experience and serves as a compelling invitation for audiences to engage with tap dance as a modern form of expression.
I do not go and see many dance shows, but I was enchanted by this show. I highly recommend it to anyone, whether you be a seasoned dance fan or not.
Ultimately, the performers utlilise their incredible talent and hard work to create a show that is enjoyable, fun and full of pizazz.
